The loaf has a textured, browned interior composed of ground meat mixed with visible flecks of vegetables (likely onions or peppers) and breadcrumbs. The exterior is coated in a thick, glossy, reddish-brown glaze that appears caramelized and slightly chunky, resembling a tomato-based sauce.
